On January 27, 2026, [Dr. Brandi Pessman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/brandipessman) gave a Nebraska R User Group presentation on "Taking the Leap and Landing Gracefully in Industry". Dr. Pessmann received her Ph.D. in Biology from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln (UNL) in May 2024, where her research focused on the effects of vibratory noise in cities on spider behavior. She continued spider-related research as a postdoctoral researcher at UNL until the summer of 2025, when she transitioned into an industry role as a data scientist at Quantum Workplace, an all-in-one HR software company that empowers every team to thrive.
